title: </sub>  Add terminal miss records to the terminal branches
text:
</sub>  Add terminal miss records to the terminal branches

For a head where every compared reviewer is clean but human adjudication finds an in-scope defect, the earlier Terminal miss record section requires the paired miss codes before that head is terminally adjudicated. This exclusive terminal-condition list instead mentions only finding outcomes or `clean_agreement`, contradicting that path and leaving operators to either exclude a valid terminal-miss head or count it without the required record; include the completed terminal-miss record as another explicit terminal branch.
